title: Central Maui Transit Hub construction and security
summary: On April 21, 2026, members added $170,000 for security at the bus hub, with nine ayes. Back in December 2023, the transportation director said he hoped the hub would open early in the new year. He also said it would connect to a planned state mixed-use project next door that is expected to include affordable rental housing.
